title: Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model
title_zh: 目标导向的视觉反事实解释方法 MACE 发布

paragraphs.en: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision–language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce M ask-guided A daptive C ounterfactual E xplanations (MACE), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source–target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate MACE on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MACE-04BC/ .
paragraphs.zh: 当前对对比视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的解释方法主要能识别重要区域，但并未说明如何修改输入以获得目标预测。 我们提出了 M ask-guided A daptive C ounterfactual E xplanations（MACE），这是一种专为 CLIP 零样本分类设计的靶向视觉反事实解释方法。 MACE 会从源归属或源-目标归属差异中构建一个可编辑区域，并且仅在必要时扩展掩码，以达到指定的目标类别。 随后，一个潜在扩散图像修复模型会修改选中的区域，而一个冻结的 CLIP 模型则提供修改指导，并将图像的其余内容锚定在原始输入上。 我们在 ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets 和 CUB-200 数据集上对 MACE 进行了评估。 源掩码变体在所有四个数据集中都实现了最高的目标 top-1 成功率，而差异掩码变体则产生了最小的像素级和感知级变化，并获得了最佳真实感评分。 两种变体在使用相同生成主干网络的 Stable Diffusion 基线模型时，都提升了预测的接近度和真实感。 这些结果表明，自适应掩码引导的编辑方法能够生成有效的 CLIP 反事实解释。 它们还揭示了反事实有效性与源图像保留性之间的权衡关系。 源代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MACE-04BC/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: CLIP [ 28 ] is widely used for zero-shot classification [ 31 , 22 , 26 ] , retrieval [ 27 , 39 , 30 ] , and multimodal applications ranging from safety inspection [ 34 , 25 ] to decision support [ 45 ] . However, CLIP explanations remain dominated by attention and gradient maps, which highlight relevant regions without showing how the input must change to alter the prediction [ 19 , 44 , 21 ] . Counterfactual explanations address this limitation by identifying a small, meaningful change that produces a different model outcome [ 35 ] .
paragraphs.zh: CLIP [ 28 ] 被广泛用于零样本分类 [ 31 , 22 , 26 ]、检索 [ 27 , 39 , 30 ]，以及从安全检测 [ 34 , 25 ] 到决策支持 [ 45 ] 的多模态应用。 然而，CLIP 的解释仍然主要依赖注意力和梯度图，这些方法虽然能突出相关区域，却无法展示输入需要如何变化才能改变预测结果 [ 19 , 44 , 21 ]。 反事实解释通过识别一个能产生不同模型结果的小而有意义的变化，解决了这一局限性 [ 35 ]。

paragraphs.en: Existing visual counterfactual methods mainly target conventional classifiers and optimize class logits or probabilities [ 10 , 5 , 1 ] . CLIP-guided editing methods instead optimize alignment with a target prompt [ 40 , 9 ] , but prompt alignment does not ensure that the target becomes the top prediction within the full zero-shot class set. These methods also do not necessarily produce the smallest localized edit responsible for the decision change.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的视觉反事实方法主要针对传统分类器，并优化类别的 logits 或概率 [ 10 , 5 , 1 ] 。 相比之下，由 CLIP 引导的编辑方法则优化与目标提示词的匹配度 [ 40 , 9 ] ，但提示词匹配并不保证该目标会成为完整零样本类别集合中的首选预测。 这些方法也不一定能产生导致决策变化的最小局部化编辑。

paragraphs.en: We therefore propose M ask-guided A daptive C ounterfactual E xplanations (MACE) (overview in Fig. 1 ), a method for targeted visual counterfactual explanations of CLIP zero-shot predictions. To our knowledge, MACE is the first image-level counterfactual method designed specifically for this setting. It uses CLIP attribution to localize editable regions and CLIP-guided diffusion inpainting to generate target features while preserving the remaining image. We consider two variants: a source-attribution mask and a source–target difference mask. Starting from a small editable region, MACE expands the mask only when needed and selects the smallest mask that changes the zero-shot prediction.

paragraphs.en: We introduce MACE, the first image-level counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE combines adaptive attribution masks, localized diffusion inpainting, and CLIP decision guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MACE，这是首个专为 CLIP 零样本分类设计、基于图像级别的反事实方法。 MACE 结合了自适应归因掩码、局部化扩散修复以及 CLIP 决策引导。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two mask variants on four datasets and show consistent gains in validity, proximity, and realism over full-image diffusion editing.

paragraphs.en: Visual counterfactual explanations identify how an image should be modified to obtain a desired target prediction while preserving its original content. Early work by Goyal et al. [10] constructs counterfactuals by replacing discriminative regions of a query image with regions from a distractor image belonging to the target class. Later approaches [ 5 , 33 ] improve sparsity, semantic consistency, and visual realism through localized optimization or generative priors.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉反事实解释能够确定需要对图像进行何种修改，才能在保留其原始内容的同时获得期望的目标预测。Goyal 等人 [10] 的早期研究通过用目标类别中干扰图像的局部区域替换查询图像的判别性区域来构建反事实。后续的方法 [5, 33] 则通过局部优化或生成先验，提升了反事实的稀疏性、语义一致性和视觉真实感。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based methods further constrain counterfactuals to the natural-image manifold. DiME [ 15 ] and DVCE [ 1 ] guide the diffusion process using classifier objectives and similarity regularization, producing realistic prediction-changing edits. Recent approaches [ 41 , 16 , 32 ] improve spatial control or reduce access requirements through object-aware editing, region-constrained generation, and black-box optimization. However, these methods are primarily designed for conventional CNN classifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的方法进一步将反事实约束在自然图像流形上。 DiME [ 15 ] 和 DVCE [ 1 ] 利用分类器目标和相似性正则化引导扩散过程，生成能够改变预测结果的逼真编辑。 近期的方法 [ 41 , 16 , 32 ] 通过对象感知编辑、区域约束生成和黑盒优化，提升了空间控制能力或降低了访问要求。 然而，这些方法主要是为传统的 CNN 分类器设计的。

paragraphs.en: CLIP [ 28 ] has mainly been interpreted using attribution, localization, and concept-based explanations. CLIP Surgery [ 19 ] shows that directly applying conventional CAM-style methods to CLIP can produce noisy or contradictory maps and proposes feature-level modifications for more faithful localization. Other methods explain CLIP predictions through multimodal information bottlenecks, sparse concept decompositions, or gradient-based attribution [ 37 , 3 , 44 ] .
paragraphs.zh: CLIP [ 28 ] 主要通过归因、定位和基于概念的解释方法被解读。 CLIP Surgery [ 19 ] 表明，直接将传统的 CAM 风格方法应用于 CLIP 可能会产生噪声多或相互矛盾的定位图，因此该方法提出了特征层面的修改以实现更准确的定位。 其他方法则通过多模态信息瓶颈、稀疏概念分解或基于梯度的归因方法来解释 CLIP 的预测结果 [ 37 , 3 , 44 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These approaches identify image regions or concepts that contribute to image–text similarity, but they remain observational. They do not determine whether modifying the highlighted evidence is sufficient to change CLIP’s zero-shot prediction.

paragraphs.en: A related line of work uses CLIP as a semantic supervision signal for image manipulation. StyleCLIP [ 24 ] and StyleGAN-NADA [ 9 ] optimize latent directions or generator parameters so that synthesized images align with target text descriptions. DiffusionCLIP [ 17 ] extends this paradigm to diffusion models, enabling text-driven edits of real images while preserving their visual identity.
paragraphs.zh: 相关研究将 CLIP 用作图像处理的语义监督信号。 StyleCLIP [ 24 ] 和 StyleGAN-NADA [ 9 ] 通过优化潜在方向或生成器参数，使合成图像与目标文本描述保持一致。 DiffusionCLIP [ 17 ] 将这一范式扩展到扩散模型中，实现了基于文本的真实图像编辑，同时保留了其视觉特征。

paragraphs.en: Counterfactuals have also been used during vision–language model training. Counterfactual Prompt Learning [ 11 ] constructs sparse feature-space counterfactuals to improve prompt generalization , while COMO [ 18 ] and CF-VLM [ 42 ] generate multimodal counterfactual examples as hard negatives to improve compositional understanding and sensitivity to semantic changes. These methods modify the training process or representation space, but they do not provide image-level explanations for individual predictions of an already trained model.

paragraphs.en: We study visual counterfactual explanations for CLIP-based zero-shot classification. Our method operates directly in CLIP’s joint image–text embedding space and generates an explicit counterfactual image. paragraphs.en: To describe the experimental protocol used to evaluate MACE, we first introduce the datasets and source–target pair selection procedure, then define the metrics used to assess validity, proximity, and realism. Finally, we provide the implementation and configuration details and describe the controlled diffusion baseline used for comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 为描述用于评估 MACE 的实验方案，我们首先介绍数据集以及源-目标对的选择流程，然后定义用于评估有效性、接近性和真实性的指标。 最后，我们提供实现和配置细节，并描述用于比较的受控扩散基线模型。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on ImageNet-1k [ 8 ] , Food-101 [ 6 ] , Oxford-IIIT Pet [ 23 ] , and CUB-200-2011 [ 36 ] , using the ImageNet validation split and the official test splits of the other three datasets. We include only images for which zero-shot CLIP predicts the ground-truth class as top-1 when scoring against the full dataset vocabulary using class-name prompts. For each selected image, the highest-scoring non-source class is used as the target. Because the source class is ranked first, this target corresponds to CLIP rank 2.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ImageNet-1k [ 8 ]、Food-101 [ 6 ]、Oxford-IIIT Pet [ 23 ] 和 CUB-200-2011 [ 36 ] 数据集上进行评估，并使用 ImageNet 的验证集以及其余三个数据集的官方测试集。 我们仅包含那些在通过类名提示词对完整数据集词汇表进行评分时，零样本 CLIP 将真实类别预测为前 1 名的图像。 对于每张选中的图像，得分最高的非源类别被用作目标。 由于源类别排在第一位，因此该目标对应于 CLIP 的排名 2。

paragraphs.en: For ImageNet, we score at most 20 validation images from each class and select the first eligible image. If none of the 20 images is eligible, that class is omitted. This produces 934 source–target pairs. For Food-101, we score 20 images and select a maximum of 10 eligible per class, producing 1,003 pairs. For Oxford-IIIT Pet, we score the full test split and select a maximum of 35 per class, producing 1,194 pairs. For CUB-200-2011, we score all 5,794 test images against 200 bird classes and select a maximum of 10 correctly classified images per class. This produces 1,595 pairs from 186 source classes. Ablations use a separate 100-instance subset with one example from each of 100 source classes.

paragraphs.en: Because existing visual counterfactual methods [ 10 , 41 , 16 , 32 ] are designed mainly for supervised classifiers and require nontrivial adaptation to CLIP, we use a controlled Stable Diffusion baseline with the same generative backbone as our method.
paragraphs.zh: 由于现有的视觉反事实方法 [ 10 , 41 , 16 , 32 ] 主要面向有监督分类器设计，且需要针对 CLIP 进行非平凡的调整，因此我们采用了一个受控的 Stable Diffusion 基线模型，其生成主干网络与我们的方法相同。

paragraphs.en: Stable Diffusion-only uses the same Stable Diffusion v1.5 inpainting checkpoint 1 , resolution, denoising steps, classifier-free guidance scale [ 14 ] , seed, and target prompt, but edits the full image using only diffusion text conditioning. It uses no attribution mask or external CLIP guidance and sets inpainting strength to 1.0. The baseline is evaluated on the same source images, targets, prompts, and evaluation pipeline as our method.
paragraphs.zh: Stable Diffusion-only 使用相同的 Stable Diffusion v1.5 局部重绘检查点 [1]、分辨率、降噪步数、无分类器引导比例 [14]、种子和目标提示词，但仅通过扩散文本条件对整张图片进行编辑。 它不使用任何归因掩码或外部 CLIP 引导，并将局部重绘强度设为 1.0。 基线方法在与我们方法相同的源图像、目标图像、提示词和评估流程上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MACE through quantitative and qualitative comparisons with the Stable Diffusion-only baseline. We first examine validity, proximity, and realism across four datasets, and then analyze representative examples to illustrate the behavior, tradeoffs, and failure modes of the two mask variants.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的基线模型进行定量和定性比较，来评估 MACE。 我们首先在四个数据集上检验有效性、接近度和真实感，然后分析代表性示例，以说明两种掩码变体的行为、权衡以及失效模式。

sents.en: We evaluate MACE through quantitative and qualitative comparisons with the Stable Diffusion-only baseline.
sents.zh: 我们通过仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的基线模型进行定量和定性比较，来评估 MACE。

sents.en: We first examine validity, proximity, and realism across four datasets, and then analyze representative examples to illustrate the behavior, tradeoffs, and failure modes of the two mask variants.
sents.zh: 我们首先在四个数据集上检验有效性、接近度和真实感，然后分析代表性示例，以说明两种掩码变体的行为、权衡以及失效模式。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares the two MACE mask variants with the Stable Diffusion-only baseline: MACE s uses the source-attribution mask, whereas MACE d uses the source–target difference mask. We evaluate validity using the target top-1 success rate, proximity using normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distances, LPIPS, and SSIM, and realism using FID and KID. For a fair comparison, all proximity metrics are computed on the same set of successful counterfactual examples across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 将两种 MACE 掩码变体与仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的基线模型进行了比较：MACE s 使用源归属掩码，而 MACE d 则使用源-目标差异掩码。 我们使用目标 top-1 成功率来评估有效性，使用归一化的 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 和 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 距离、LPIPS 和 SSIM 来评估接近度，并使用 FID 和 KID 来评估真实性。 为确保公平比较，所有接近度指标均基于各方法中成功反事实示例的同一集合进行计算。

paragraphs.en: Despite using the same generative backbone and target prompt as the baseline, MACE s achieves the highest validity across all four datasets. MACE d achieves the lowest normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distances and LPIPS, the highest SSIM, and the best FID and KID on every dataset. Both MACE variants outperform Stable Diffusion-only on all proximity and realism metrics. Lower ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distances indicate better pixel-level preservation, lower LPIPS indicates greater perceptual similarity, and higher SSIM indicates better structural preservation. Together, these results show the benefit of mask-guided editing with CLIP guidance over full-image diffusion editing.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 MACE s 与基线模型使用了相同的生成主干和目标提示，但在所有四个数据集上均实现了最高的有效性。 在所有数据集中，MACE d 实现了最低的归一化 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 和 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 距离以及 LPIPS，最高的 SSIM，以及最佳的 FID 和 KID。 在所有邻近性和真实感指标上，两种 MACE 变体均优于仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的方法。 较低的 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 和 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 距离表示像素级保留效果更佳，较低的 LPIPS 表示感知相似性更高，而较高的 SSIM 则表示结构保留更优。 综合来看，这些结果表明，与全图像扩散编辑相比，结合 CLIP 引导的掩码指导编辑更具优势。

paragraphs.en: Because the proximity metrics are computed on the same set of valid counterfactuals, the consistent gains of MACE d over MACE s show that the difference mask keeps the output closer to the source image. Its lower FID and KID also indicate better realism. These gains come at the cost of lower validity, revealing a validity–proximity tradeoff. By focusing edits on regions where source evidence exceeds target evidence, MACE d may also provide a more concise explanation of the changes needed to reach the target class.

paragraphs.en: MACE performs strongly on general object recognition with ImageNet, food recognition with Food-101, fine-grained pet classification with Oxford Pets, and fine-grained bird classification with CUB-200. This consistency suggests that the method generalizes across class vocabularies and levels of visual granularity. In contrast, Stable Diffusion-only achieves high validity on Food-101 and Oxford Pets but performs worse on ImageNet and especially CUB-200. Text-conditioned full-image generation may capture broad target characteristics more easily than the subtle, localized cues needed to distinguish visually similar bird species.
paragraphs.zh: MACE 在 ImageNet 上的通用物体识别、Food-101 上的食物识别、Oxford Pets 上的细粒度宠物分类以及 CUB-200 上的细粒度鸟类分类任务中均表现优异。 这种一致性表明，该方法能够泛化到不同的类别词汇表和视觉精细程度。 相比之下，仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的方法在 Food-101 和 Oxford Pets 上实现了较高的有效性，但在 ImageNet 上的表现较差，尤其是在 CUB-200 上。 文本条件化的完整图像生成可能更容易捕捉目标的大致特征，而非区分外观相似的鸟类物种所需的细微局部线索。

paragraphs.en: MACE generally preserves the identity, pose, background, and composition of the source image while adding target-specific features. For example, in the grilled cheese sandwich → \rightarrow club sandwich transition, both MACE variants modify the filling while keeping the plate and surrounding objects fixed. Similarly, for Miniature Pinscher → \rightarrow Scottish Terrier, MACE introduces Terrier-specific facial and fur characteristics while maintaining the original pose, scale, and grassy background. In contrast, Stable Diffusion-only often regenerates the full image, changing the object appearance, viewpoint, and background together.
paragraphs.zh: MACE 通常在添加目标特定特征的同时，保留源图像的身份、姿态、背景和构图。 例如，在烤奶酪三明治 → \rightarrow 俱乐部三明治的转换中，两种 MACE 变体都修改了馅料，同时保留了餐盘和周围物体的固定状态。 同样地，对于迷你品犬 → \rightarrow 苏格兰梗的转换，MACE 引入了苏格兰梗特有的面部和毛发特征，同时保持了原有的姿态、比例和草地背景。 相比之下，仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的方法通常会重新生成整张图片，导致物体外观、视角和背景一同改变。

paragraphs.en: The two masks also produce visibly different edit sizes. MACE s often changes a broader discriminative region, whereas MACE d focuses on smaller source-specific cues. In the Cedar Waxwing → \rightarrow Bohemian Waxwing example, MACE d mainly changes the crown color, while MACE s modifies a larger part of the head. This pattern matches the quantitative tradeoff between the higher validity of MACE s and the better proximity of MACE d .
paragraphs.zh: 这两种掩码产生的编辑规模也存在明显差异。 MACE s 通常会改变一个更广泛的判别区域，而 MACE d 则专注于更小且与源图相关的特征。 在 Cedar Waxwing → \rightarrow Bohemian Waxwing 的例子中，MACE d 主要改变了头冠颜色，而 MACE s 则修改了头部更大的一部分。 这种模式与 MACE s 更高的有效性和 MACE d 更优的接近性之间的量化权衡相吻合。

paragraphs.en: Failures reflect limited masks, persistent source evidence, and missing fine-grained cues. The failure cases show three main limitations. First, MACE d may use a mask that is too small to add enough target evidence, as in French fries → \rightarrow fish and chips and Abyssinian → \rightarrow Siamese. MACE s succeeds in the Food-101 example because its larger mask allows it to add visible fish. Second, strong source evidence may remain after editing. For solar dish → \rightarrow radio telescope, both MACE variants preserve the dominant dish structure, and CLIP may view the two classes as visually similar. For Abyssinian → \rightarrow Siamese, MACE s adds blue eyes and darker facial features, but the original coat and body still support the source class. Third, fine-grained edits may look plausible but miss the exact cues needed for the target class, as seen in CUB-200. Stable Diffusion-only also fails in these cases despite making larger changes because it may generate the wrong object or class, such as fries instead of fish, a generic cat instead of a Siamese, or an off-target bird. These cases motivate larger maximum masks, stronger class-specific guidance, and prompts that describe the target’s key visual features.
paragraphs.zh: 失败案例反映了掩膜范围有限、源类别证据持续存在以及精细特征缺失等问题。 这些失败案例揭示了三个主要局限性。 首先，MACE d 可能使用的掩膜过小，无法添加足够的目标类别证据，例如“French fries”→“fish and chips”以及“Abyssinian”→“Siamese”的情况。 MACE s 在 Food-101 示例中能够成功，是因为其更大的掩膜允许它添加可见的鱼。 其次，编辑后可能仍存在较强的源类别证据。 在“solar dish”→“radio telescope”的例子中，两种 MACE 变体都保留了主要的碟形结构，而 CLIP 可能认为这两个类别在视觉上相似。 对于“Abyssinian”→“Siamese”，MACE s 虽然添加了蓝色眼睛和更深的面部特征，但原有的皮毛和身体特征仍然支持源类别。 第三，精细编辑可能看似合理，却遗漏了目标类别所需的关键特征，这在 CUB-200 中有所体现。 仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的方法在这些案例中也会失败，尽管它进行了更大的改动，因为它可能会生成错误的物体或类别，例如生成薯条而非鱼、一只普通的猫而非暹罗猫，或者一个偏离目标类别的鸟类。 这些案例表明，需要采用更大的最大掩膜、更强的类别特定引导，以及能够描述目标类别关键视觉特征的提示词。

sents.zh: 这些失败案例揭示了三个主要局限性。

sents.en: First, MACE d may use a mask that is too small to add enough target evidence, as in French fries → \rightarrow fish and chips and Abyssinian → \rightarrow Siamese.
sents.zh: 首先，MACE d 可能使用的掩膜过小，无法添加足够的目标类别证据，例如“French fries”→“fish and chips”以及“Abyssinian”→“Siamese”的情况。

sents.en: MACE s succeeds in the Food-101 example because its larger mask allows it to add visible fish.
sents.zh: MACE s 在 Food-101 示例中能够成功，是因为其更大的掩膜允许它添加可见的鱼。

sents.en: Second, strong source evidence may remain after editing.
sents.zh: 其次，编辑后可能仍存在较强的源类别证据。

sents.en: For solar dish → \rightarrow radio telescope, both MACE variants preserve the dominant dish structure, and CLIP may view the two classes as visually similar.
sents.zh: 在“solar dish”→“radio telescope”的例子中，两种 MACE 变体都保留了主要的碟形结构，而 CLIP 可能认为这两个类别在视觉上相似。

sents.en: For Abyssinian → \rightarrow Siamese, MACE s adds blue eyes and darker facial features, but the original coat and body still support the source class.
sents.zh: 对于“Abyssinian”→“Siamese”，MACE s 虽然添加了蓝色眼睛和更深的面部特征，但原有的皮毛和身体特征仍然支持源类别。

sents.en: Third, fine-grained edits may look plausible but miss the exact cues needed for the target class, as seen in CUB-200.
sents.zh: 第三，精细编辑可能看似合理，却遗漏了目标类别所需的关键特征，这在 CUB-200 中有所体现。

sents.en: Stable Diffusion-only also fails in these cases despite making larger changes because it may generate the wrong object or class, such as fries instead of fish, a generic cat instead of a Siamese, or an off-target bird.
sents.zh: 仅使用 Stable Diffusion 的方法在这些案例中也会失败，尽管它进行了更大的改动，因为它可能会生成错误的物体或类别，例如生成薯条而非鱼、一只普通的猫而非暹罗猫，或者一个偏离目标类别的鸟类。

sents.en: These cases motivate larger maximum masks, stronger class-specific guidance, and prompts that describe the target’s key visual features.
sents.zh: 这些案例表明，需要采用更大的最大掩膜、更强的类别特定引导，以及能够描述目标类别关键视觉特征的提示词。

paragraphs.en: We study how CLIP guidance strength and mask fraction affect validity and proximity. We use 100 examples from each dataset and vary one parameter at a time while keeping the remaining configuration fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了 CLIP 引导强度与掩码比例如何影响有效性和接近度。 我们从每个数据集中使用 100 个示例，每次仅改变一个参数，同时保持其余配置不变。

sents.en: We study how CLIP guidance strength and mask fraction affect validity and proximity.
sents.zh: 我们研究了 CLIP 引导强度与掩码比例如何影响有效性和接近度。

sents.en: We use 100 examples from each dataset and vary one parameter at a time while keeping the remaining configuration fixed.
sents.zh: 我们从每个数据集中使用 100 个示例，每次仅改变一个参数，同时保持其余配置不变。

paragraphs.en: Stronger CLIP guidance improves validity, while mask-size effects vary by dataset. Figure 3(a) shows that stronger CLIP guidance generally improves validity across datasets and mask types, with the largest gains for the difference mask. The effect of a fixed mask fraction is more dataset-dependent. Figure 3(b) shows that larger masks strongly improve validity on Food-101, whereas the source mask on CUB-200 does not improve monotonically. Because each mask fraction produces an independent candidate rather than extending the same output, a larger mask does not always result in higher validity.
paragraphs.zh: 更强的 CLIP 引导能提升有效性，而掩码大小的影响因数据集而异。 图 3(a) 显示，更强的 CLIP 引导通常能在不同数据集和掩码类型中提升有效性，其中差异掩码的增益最大。 固定掩码比例的影响更依赖于具体数据集。 图 3(b) 显示，在 Food-101 上，更大的掩码能显著提升有效性，而在 CUB-200 上，源掩码的有效性并未单调提升。 由于每个掩码比例都会生成一个独立的候选结果，而不是扩展同一个输出，因此更大的掩码并不总能带来更高的有效性。

paragraphs.en: CLIP guidance improves measured proximity, while larger fixed masks cause larger edits. Figure 4 shows how CLIP guidance strength and mask size affect pixel-level proximity. Increasing the guidance strength generally lowers the normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance, with most of the improvement around a scale of 0.4 and little improvement thereafter. However, qualitative examples in Sec. A.3 of the supplementary material show that stronger guidance can introduce visible artifacts that ℓ 1 \ell_{1} does not capture. Increasing the fixed mask fraction causes larger pixel changes, especially for the source mask, while the difference mask remains more conservative. The remaining proximity metrics show similar trends and are reported in Sec. A.1 of the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: CLIP引导机制提升了测得的接近度，而更大的固定掩码会导致更大幅度的编辑。图4展示了CLIP引导强度与掩码大小如何影响像素级的接近度。提高引导强度通常会降低归一化的 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 距离，其中大部分改进出现在0.4左右的规模之后，提升则微乎其微。然而，补充材料中A.3节的定性示例表明，更强的引导可能会引入肉眼可见的伪影，而这些是 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 无法捕捉到的。增加固定掩码的比例会导致像素变化更大，尤其是在源掩码上，而差异掩码则保持更为保守。其余的接近度指标也呈现出类似的趋势，并在补充材料的A.1节中进行了报告。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive mask expansion improves validity while preserving proximity. The varying effect of mask size motivates adaptive expansion, which evaluates progressively larger masks and returns the first successful candidate. To measure its benefit, we compare the fixed mask fractions in Figures 3(b) and 4(b) with adaptive expansion up to the same maximum fractions in Figures 3(c) and 4(c) . Adaptive expansion improves validity for both mask types across datasets, with larger gains at higher maximum fractions, while maintaining much lower normalized ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distances than fixed masks at the same fractions. Results for the remaining proximity metrics are reported in Sec. A.2 of the supplementary material. By stopping at a smaller successful mask, the adaptive procedure increases the chance of finding a valid counterfactual without requiring the full edit budget.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应掩码扩展在保持邻近性的同时提升了有效性。掩码尺寸变化的影响促使了自适应扩展的提出，该方法会逐步评估更大尺寸的掩码，并返回第一个成功的候选方案。为衡量其优势，我们将图3(b)和图4(b)中的固定掩码比例与图3(c)和图4(c)中扩展至相同最大比例的自适应掩码进行了比较。在各类数据集上，自适应扩展对两种类型的掩码都提升了有效性，且最大比例越高，提升效果越显著；同时，在相同比例下，其归一化 ℓ₁ 距离（ℓ₁）远低于固定掩码。其余邻近性指标的结果见补充材料中的附录A.2。由于自适应方法会在较小的成功掩码处停止，因此无需使用完整的编辑预算，便增加了找到有效反事实实例的可能性。

paragraphs.en: We introduced MACE, a method for generating targeted visual counterfactual explanations for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE combines class-conditioned attribution, adaptive mask expansion, and CLIP-guided diffusion inpainting to change the model’s prediction to a target label while preserving image content outside the editable region. Experiments on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200 demonstrate the value of coupling localized editing with explicit decision guidance. The source-attribution variant achieves the highest validity across all four datasets, whereas the source–target difference variant consistently produces smaller pixel and perceptual changes and better realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over full-image Stable Diffusion editing. These results establish adaptive masking as an effective mechanism for balancing validity against source-image preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MACE，一种为 CLIP 零样本分类生成目标视觉反事实解释的方法。 MACE 结合了类条件归因、自适应掩码扩展和由 CLIP 引导的扩散图像修复技术，在保留可编辑区域以外图像内容的同时，将模型预测更改为目标标签。 在 ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets 和 CUB-200 上的实验表明，将局部编辑与明确的决策引导相结合具有显著价值。 在所有四个数据集中，源归因变体的有效性最高，而源–目标差异变体则始终能产生更小的像素和感知变化，并实现更高的真实感评分。 两种变体在邻近性和真实感方面均优于对整张图片进行 Stable Diffusion 编辑的方法。 这些结果确立了自适应掩码作为平衡有效性与保留原始图像之间关系的一种有效机制。

paragraphs.en: Several directions remain for future work. First, MACE currently optimizes the pairwise source–target score difference, which encourages the target class to outrank the source class but does not explicitly require it to outrank every class in the zero-shot label set. Future work could instead use a multiclass or margin-based objective that directly targets top-1 prediction. Second, because different CLIP guidance strengths and mask fractions produce distinct generations rather than incremental extensions of the same output, jointly optimizing these parameters could improve the balance between validity and preservation. Finally, future studies could apply MACE to data augmentation and robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作仍有多条方向可循。 首先，MACE 目前优化的是成对的源–目标分数差异，这会促使目标类别的排名高于源类别，但并未明确要求其必须高于零样本标签集中的所有类别。 未来的研究可以转而采用多类别或基于边界的优化目标，直接针对前 1 名预测进行优化。 其次，由于不同的 CLIP 引导强度和掩码比例会产生截然不同的生成结果，而非对同一输出的渐进式扩展，因此联合优化这些参数可能有助于在有效性与保留性之间取得更好的平衡。 最后，未来的研究还可以将 MACE 应用于数据增强和鲁棒性提升。
